supersession_reason: Pre-freeze candidate revision after actual repository-secret availability and zero-spend access constraints were surfaced. No receiver registry had been frozen and no CSH corpus-bearing hosted execution occurred under v0.1 candidate identities.
preflight_rule: Hosted identities, endpoint compatibility, requested parameters, response format, quota/entitlement availability, and returned model identity must be confirmed using a neutral non-corpus prompt before registry freeze. Failure requires candidate revision before freeze; no silent receiver substitution.
zero_spend_constraint: Do not purchase credits or add a payment method solely to satisfy CSH-S001. A candidate that requires new researcher expenditure is ineligible for this successor unless separately authorized before freeze.
non_claims: Repository-secret presence is not evidence of valid credentials, usable quota, free credits, model entitlement, or successful provider access.
A successful neutral preflight is not a CSH result.
A failed access preflight is not an adverse CSH hypothesis result.
Receiver feasibility does not establish cross-organizational generality.
